Junior Software Engineer

About the role
We are looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our product engineering team. You will build and maintain features across our web platform, working closely with senior engineers, product and design.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and test features for our customer-facing web application
- Write clean, maintainable code in Python or Java and participate in code reviews
- Build and consume REST APIs and work with relational databases
- Debug production issues and improve application performance
- Collaborate in an Agile team with two-week sprints

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- 0-2 years of experience in software development (internships count)
- Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and object-oriented programming
- Experience with Python or Java
- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
- Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
- Understanding of REST APIs

Nice to have
- Experience with React or another modern JavaScript framework
- Exposure to Docker, CI/CD or AWS
- Experience writing unit tests
